name: Dumbbell Seated Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell at each side and your palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows at your sides.
Extend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside the bench.
tips: Keep your feet planted and your torso upright.
Avoid swinging the dumbbells from the bottom or letting your elbows drift forward.
